# MouseDeviceName

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MouseDeviceName:String device:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device` | In | Int32 | required | The mouse to ask, counted from 0 in the order they were seen. |

**Returns:** The name, or an empty string if there is no mouse with that number.

## Description

Tells the name of a mouse, as the system gives it.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Text 10, 10, "First mouse: " + MouseDeviceName(0)
Flip
WaitKey
```
